objective: Correct intelTHAT from a panel-shaped integration into a real, native Market Compass research application without importing donor execution authority.

source.license_observation: No license file was observed at the pinned revision; donor code is not copied or executed.

outcomes.evidence: The former intelTHAT surface was a workspace panel with two readers, a proof-state filter, evidence cards, and export; it did not provide an application shell or application-owned workflow state.
The dedicated /intelthat/ route provides Cockpit, Market Pack, Macro Conditions, News Intelligence, SEC Monitor, and Run History rooms with System, Light, and Dark presentation.

Run all research and Read owner receipts call separate bounded APIs; company-name resolution, measured elapsed time, save/restore, room navigation, evidence inspection, and JSON export change real application state.

The app runs only Market Compass-owned readers. It does not install or run donor code and permanently refuses broker OAuth, credentials, account data, orders, execution, position management, trade recording, money movement, and performance promises.
66 pytest cases passed; Ruff passed; node --check passed for intelthat-app.js; git diff --check passed.

Candidate must still be committed, pass exact-head forge checks, receive independent review, merge to canonical main, mirror, install on FiveMac, and pass browser proof through http://market-compass.localhost/intelthat/.
